R7AH-grouse-drive-0001.name: By Germansen River
R7AH-grouse-drive-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7AH-grouse-drive-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Thutade-Manson FSR (paved road)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
10 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
9 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: M.U.s 7-38 and 7-39. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 7-1/23.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 7A table (page 57), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). MU 7-1 is listed in Region 7A on page 2 but no row names it.

plan: Drive: from Germansen Landing, about 15 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Thutade FSR, Thutade-Manson FSR.
Park: 55.68403, -124.64399, pull off on Thutade-Manson FSR (paved road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Thutade-Manson FSR stretch, 5.3 km one way. About 106 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-38, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2024-07-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AH-grouse-drive-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-38: about 1,923 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.15 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
